title: MCC agent protocol
description: Messages exchanged over the agent WebSocket. Every message carries type, v (protocol version) and id. Generated types: protocol/gen/messages.ts and agent/internal/protocol/messages.go (run `bun run protocol:gen`).

Platform.description: Host operating system and CPU architecture.

AgentAssignmentState.description: Assignment states an agent reports. The control plane maps running to idle or busy.

AssignmentReport.description: One assignment the agent currently knows about.

code.description: Why it failed, for the control plane to act on: see Status.code

exit_code.description: A task's exit code, when it ran to an exit. Absent means 0

ImageSpec.description: An image the agent may prepare and run.

name.description: Stable image name within the tenant

source.description: Where this host fetches the image, for example ghcr.io/cirruslabs/macos-sequoia-xcode:latest. The control plane has already chosen the source for this host's system

Isolation.description: Where work runs: in a virtual machine made for it, or directly on the host. Absent means vm.

image.description: ImageSpec.name. Absent for a pool whose work runs on the host itself

TaskParam.description: One parameter of a task. A list of these rather than an object, so that the generated types stay simple.

TaskCapacity.description: A task the host's owner has declared in its policy. The control plane sends a task only to hosts that list it.

timeout_seconds.description: The longest the owner lets it run

max_concurrent.description: Most runs of it at once; 0 means only the host's slots limit them

Workload.description: What to run. The agent maps kind to a fixed entry command, or for a task to the command its owner declared under that name; there is no free-form command.

jit_config.description: github-runner only: GitHub just-in-time runner configuration, single use

idle_timeout_seconds.description: github-runner only: stop the work if the runner has not taken a job by then

task.description: task only: the name of a task declared in the host's policy

params.description: task only: values for the parameters the task declares

timeout_seconds.description: task only: stop it after this long, if that is sooner than the owner's own limit

Hello.description: First message from the agent, answering challenge.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over "mcc-hello\n" + nonce + "\n" + host_id

accepting.description: False outside active hours or while draining

guests.description: Guest platforms this host can run. Absent from agents that only run macOS guests

host_slots_total.description: How much work this host runs directly, without a VM, at once. Absent or 0 unless its owner allows that

tasks.description: Tasks this host's owner has declared. Absent if none

GuestCapacity.description: One guest platform a host can run, and its own limit within the host's slots.

limit.description: Most VMs of this platform at once; 0 means only slots_total limits them

code.description: Why it failed, for the control plane to act on: refused_policy (the host's own rules forbid it; trying again will not help), refused_capacity (no room just now), timeout (a task ran past its limit) or stopped (a task was stopped before it ended). Absent otherwise

exit_code.description: A task's exit code, when it ran to an exit. Absent means 0

Challenge.description: Sent by the control plane as soon as the socket opens.

version.description: Protocol version chosen for this connection

image.description: The VM's image. Absent when isolation is host
